items.quote: Didn't you ask yourself this question honestly, scrolling through the posts on LinkedIn? I did!
items.statement: Everyone who is self-promoting is creating a reaction.

items.quote: This occurred to me recently from my own “whom do you think you are….” behavior
items.statement: This occurred to me recently from my own 'whom do you think you are' behavior.

items.quote: So what you Should do instead? Idea promotion! It creates value the only thing that people would actually like and share.
items.statement: Change what you're posting about; focus on idea promotion instead of self-promotion.

items.quote: Because nothing was offered to them. Something was only claimed about you.
items.statement: If content feels only like a personal claim, audiences will likely scroll.

items.quote: And then nothing. Two likes. No comments. No DMs.
items.statement: People stop engaging when posts are self-promotional rather than valuable.

overview: LinkedIn post focusing on self-promotion versus idea promotion in content sharing.
